svg.title: A PROFINET DCP frame, and what the crate keeps of it
svg.desc: The 20 bytes of a DCP Identify request, field by field: Frame ID 0xFEFE, service 5 Identify, type 0 request, a transaction id, a response delay, the DCP data length, then one block: option 2 suboption 2 NameOfStation, length 4, plc1. The Internet struct keeps only the name Profinet: no addresses, no payload, details None. ProfinetPacket::try_from on the link payload gives the fields.
